content.title: Sebastian Fundora Vs Keith Thurman Live Results Today
content.text: Sebastian Fundora stopped Keith Thurman in the sixth round by TKO at super welterweight in Las Vegas, taking over the fight early and widening the lead each round. WBC junior middleweight champion Fundora kept a steady pace with constant punches, while Thurman tried to answer but took too many clean shots as the fight went on. The referee stepped in during round six, giving Thurman the first stoppage loss of his career. Undercard Junior middleweight Yoenis Tellez (12-1, 9 KOs) beat Brian Mendoza (23-5, 17 KOs) over 10 rounds in Las Vegas, taking a clear decision with the sharper work. Tellez used his speed and activity to stay a step ahead, keeping Mendoza from landing anything big. It’s a solid win for the 25-year-old, while Mendoza takes another loss at this stage of his career. Yoenli Hernandez (10-0, 9 KOs) stopped Terrell Gausha (24-6-1, 12 KOs) in the fourth round after a one-sided run of pressure and clean punching. Hernandez set the tone early and never let up, forcing the referee to step in as Gausha absorbed too many shots. It’s a rough night for the veteran, who suffers his first stoppage loss, while Hernandez keeps building at middleweight Heavyweight Gurgen Hovhannisyan (10-0, 9 KOs) beat Cesar Navarro (15-4, 13 KOs) over 10 rounds, keeping control with steady pressure and heavier shots. Navarro had moments, but Hovhannisyan did the clearer work and kept his unbeaten record intact. Kevin Newman II (19-3-1, 11 KOs) edged Elijah Garcia (17-2, 13 KOs) by majority decision over 10 rounds in a competitive catchweight fight, taking it 98-92, 96-94, and 95-95. Newman built an early lead behind his jab, Garcia pushed back in the middle rounds, but Newman’s cleaner shots late made the difference. It’s a tough result for Garcia in his first full fight at super middleweight, while Newman walks away with a solid upset win. Featherweight Brayan Gonzalez remained unbeaten with a fifth-round stoppage of Brandon Medina in their scheduled six-round fight. Gonzalez took control early, landing steady combinations and building a clear lead as the rounds went on. Continued pressure in round five forced the referee to step in and stop the bout. Kaipo Gallegos vs Julian Gonzalez Lightweight Kaipo Gallegos improved to 12-0-1 (9 KOs) with a unanimous decision over Julian Gonzalez across 10 rounds. Gallegos was knocked down early and had to recover, but settled into the fight and took over with higher output and cleaner work. He pulled away over the later rounds to earn a clear decision on the cards. Nelson Birchall vs Ryan Griffiths Featherweight Nelson Birchall moved to 11-0 (8 KOs) with a ninth-round stoppage of Ryan Griffiths in their 10-round fight. Birchall built control with consistent pressure and combinations, gradually wearing Griffiths down.
